system_and_ui_features.details: Redesigned pre-match layout for verifying skills and loadouts
Dedicated interface for tracking rank achievements across seasons

optimizations: In-game backpack manual sorting (ascending and descending order)
Minimap display optimizations across all game modes
Optimized vehicle honk UI control buttons
Ranked stats interface now accessible inside team lobby
In-game HUD configuration menu layout optimized
World Chat moderation system (added report option for inappropriate behavior)
HUD customization options (Emote, Pet Emote, Prone, Ping, and Legendary Costume buttons can now be toggled invisible)
